## The position — a sleeping incumbent
The supply of vehicle gas fuel (BBG) for transport in DKI Jakarta **is already carried out by PT JUP.**
JUP is not entering this market — it already operates in it.
**Six facilities. Only one runs.**
| Facility | Status |
|---|---|
| SPBG Perintis Kemerdekaan | ✅ operating |
| SPBG Kampung Rambutan | ❌ idle |
| SPBG Rawa Buaya | ❌ idle |
| SPBG Mampang | ❌ idle |
| SPBG Kramat Jati | ❌ idle |
| MRU Laguna Pluit | ❌ idle |
**Five idle assets** — the capex is already sunk. They only need switching back on.

## The business scheme
Financing (APBN / APBD / other) → **BUMD Energi (JUP)**.
Government gas allocation → **Pertamina EP + PGN** supply → JUP distributes:
- 🚌 **Transjakarta** — B-to-G, price set by government
- 🏠 **Households (Jargas)** — B-to-G, price set by government
- 🏢 **Commercial <1.000 m³/month (Horeca)** — B-to-B, **economic pricing** (investment cost + operating cost
+ the effect of the regulated household gas price)
